sentences.en: I'm afraid you must have misinterpreted my e-mail of Jun 8.
sentences.zh: 恐怕你误解了我的6月8日的邮件。

sentences.en: It's easy to misinterpret the actions and intentions of others.
sentences.zh: 很容易误解他人的行为和意图。

sentences.en: It's easy to misinterpret things when they're taken out of context.
sentences.zh: 当事情脱离了上下文时，很容易产生误解。
